// A joint that keeps the distance between two anchor points within
// [MinLength, MaxLength] (a rope when MinLength is zero, a rod when the
// bounds are equal).
type DistanceJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    MinLength: Length;
    MaxLength: Length;
}
